decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY establishing one ticket and one $5 commission per completed mint for both coded and no-code paths.
The source changes reward accounting and display behavior, not NFT transfer semantics or post-transfer ownership of rewards.
The source specifically requires accounting on the leaderboard and NFT attributes and does not change dashboard-summary behavior.
The source does not change fiat-user authentication, provisioned-wallet behavior, dashboard access, or reward-access guidance.
The existing About-page copy already describes random no-code ticket and commission allocation, and the source does not request a content revision.
With Big Block already removed, the source necessarily establishes that every completed mint generates one Small Block ticket, including random allocation when no referral code is used.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
At this point, we have completed 12 mints, so that should amount to 12 tickets & 12 x $5 commissions.

**Even if no referral code is used, a ticket and commission are still issued**.

Currently, **when a code is used**, it is accurately reflected on the leaderboards/NFT attributes. Perfect.

If **no referral code is used**, the ticket and commission are assigned at random.
(B**ut they must still be reflected on the leaderboard/NFT attributes**.)

I believe that since your most recent fix, the randomly assigned tickets from the last 2 mints have been reflected on the leaderboard/NFT attributes. Great.
However, the missing tickets have not been backfilled.

The commissions from these purchases without a code are also still not reflected on the leaderboard/NFT attributes.

In my screenshot, you will see that I have an NFT showing 2 tickets but only 1 x $5 commission. That should not be possible because each ticket includes a $5 commission.

Also, in my leaderboard screenshot, only 7 tickets and 5 x $5 commissions are accounted for out of 12 total mints.
Whether or not a referral code is used, 12 mints should result in 12 tickets and 12 x $5 commissions.

value_updates.ticket_generation_rule: Every completed mint generates one Small Block ticket, assigned to the NFT selected by the referral code when one is used or to a randomly selected NFT when no referral code is used.

decisions.reason: The source addresses on-chain NFT reward attributes rather than the separate frontend NFT-detail summary, whose general accuracy requirement remains unchanged.
The candidate already requires a $5 commission for no-code mints and random recipient selection; the source does not resolve the outstanding first-mint recipient edge case.
The retained approved FAQ already explains random no-code commission and ticket allocation, and the source does not direct a new FAQ revision.
The source's ticket and commission totals concern leaderboard and NFT reward accounting, not the candidate's mint, prize-pool, referral, or next-draw aggregate statistics.
The source does not change which NFTs must appear as owned on the dashboard.
The source necessarily broadens the $5 affiliate-commission allocation from coded primary mints to every completed primary mint, with random NFT selection for the no-code path.
